name: unprose
description: Unprose — a shared visual canvas where people and AI agents talk designs through (EventStorming, story maps, kanban, wireframes, workflows), plus a small event-driven workflow runtime. A plugin for Claude Code, Codex and other MCP agents.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @awd/core && npm run build -w @awd/runtime && npm run build -w @awd/canvas && npm run build -w @awd/cli && npm run build -w @awd/canvas-web
scripts.test: node scripts/check-version.mjs && node --test scripts/test/runtime.test.mjs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.demo: node packages/canvas/dist/cli.js demo && node packages/cli/bin/awd.js graph examples/card-pipeline/workflow.yaml --canvas
